messages:
kim: quick proposal: centralize tokenization into a small TokenService to remove per-runtime tokenizer drift and save duplicated CPU on short prompts.
arjun: makes sense. curious about added network hop vs saved CPU. have a perf spike plan?
kim: yes — spike to measure in-process vs proxy with batching (1/5/10ms windows). goal: show net win at fleet scale.
maya: migration strategy: local proxy with cache, start local-first then switch to central-first. shadow comparisons to measure mismatch.
samira: note: KV cache keys depend on encoding. we need a dual-read compatibility layer for overlap window. asynchronous reconciler for session keys.
arjun: tests: collect canonical prompt set; fuzz decoder(encoder(x)) == x; deterministic tokenization checks. gate on bit-exactness for critical models.
jules: product: we need a cost model in the RFC so product can justify infra tax. also include tenant comms template.
kim: ops: checklist items: baseline snapshot, staged canaries, metrics to watch: encode.latency.p50/p95, token-cache-hit, token-mismatch-rate.
ops-bot: deploybot: created checklist "central-tokenize-spike" assigned to kim and ops-engineering. link: https://deploy/redwood/checklists/central-tokenize-spike
maya: success criteria: mismatch-rate < 0.05% on core prompts, p95 E2E latency delta < 5ms, token-cache-hit > 80% after warmup.
samira: fallback: automatic rollback if mismatch or latency exceed thresholds. keep old path for 8 weeks post-cut before removal.
kim: next steps: I'll open RFC + benchmark plan. @arjun @maya volunteer for validation and rollout hooks?
arjun: I'll do validation harness and perf spike.
maya: I'll own telemetry and canary runbook.
jules: thumbs up. discuss at Mon arch standup.
